title: Soviet military exercise drew UFOs once nuclear weapons were brought in

tellings.quote: he's he's on video on the internet saying that uh at some point during the Soviet era he was part of a military exercise uh that was intentionally designed to try to attract UFOs

plain: During the Soviet era, the military is said to have run an exercise built to lure UFOs, and the UFOs came once nuclear weapons were brought in. Robert Hastings, a researcher who studies UFO sightings at nuclear weapons sites, tells Michels this comes from a retired Soviet army colonel, whom he does not name, who says on a video online that he took part in the exercise. If true, it would mean UFOs take a special interest in nuclear weapons, and that the Soviets tested that on purpose.
